# Critical Rules (ALL code, ALL agents)

- **Branch first**: Parallel agents run on this repo. NEVER edit on `master`. First action is `git checkout -b <name>`.
- **No stubs**: build the real thing when CI fails on a missing module. No `return null` placeholders.
- **Multi-tenant**: ALWAYS add `company_id` to every DB query. Never return data across tenants.
- **DB**: `sql` tagged template from `@/lib/neon` (legacy path; runtime is Supabase/pg). NEVER string-concat.
- **API handlers**: `withAuth(withErrorHandler(handler as any))` from `@/lib/auth`. Legacy `withCompany` is removed.
- **Responses**: `apiResponse.success / badRequest / notFound` from `@/lib/apiResponse`.
- **Logging**: `log` from `@/lib/logger` — never `console.log`.
- **Error handling**: no empty `catch` blocks.
- **Types**: 100% TypeScript coverage; no `any` outside Next.js patterns.
- **File size**: max 300 lines.
- **Dates**: pg returns `Date` objects from timestamp columns.
- **Customer invoices**: use `COALESCE(ci.client_id, ci.customer_id)`.
- **Nav**: update `src/components/accounting/accountingNavConfig.ts` for every new page.
- **Migrations**: next unused 3-digit prefix, `IF NOT EXISTS`, no prefix reuse.

## Commands
- `bun run dev` (:3200) · `bun run lint` · `bun run type-check` · `bun run test:unit` · `bun run ci` · `bun run db:migrate` · `bash scripts/deploy.sh`
